rule_title: TTP 1543.003 - New Service Persistence via PowerShell New-Service Cmdlet
description: Detects creation of a new Windows service via the PowerShell New-Service cmdlet where the binary path invokes cmd.exe or powershell.exe, often with encoded commands or execution policy bypass flags. Commonly used for persistence while masquerading as a legitimate Windows service (e.g. 'Windows Health Service', 'SecurityHealthSvc'). Requires PowerShell Script Block Logging (EID 4104) enabled.
